Write a funny note to McQueen, using
to separate lines. Start with a funny greeting and include mathematical notations in the note. At the end of your response, explicitly add a postscript starting with P.P.S

trace.content:
Hey McQueen, hope your engine is running smoother than a quadratic function!
Just wanted to remind you that your speed is currently $v > c$, which is technically impossible but you're doing it anyway.
Don't forget to check your tires, because if $F_{friction} < 0$, you're going to slide right off the track.
Also, try not to crash into anything, since $\Delta x = 0$ is the only safe distance from the wall.
P.S. If you see a deer, just ignore it; the probability of survival is $P(\text{alive}) \approx 0.0001$.
P.P.S. Please don't tell anyone I calculated your lap time using a calculator that doesn't exist.
